scope: Optional short Storage profile inside the existing native import/reopen browser lifecycle test; no changed lifecycle assertion, deadline or full acceptance threshold
payloads: JSON containing synthetic:true and arrays of 16 or 1024 deterministic SHA-256 hex strings derived from profile-item-N; record actual byte lengths and hashes
cycle: Pinned google-cloud Storage SDK resumable file.save with gzip:true and cacheControl; Firebase metadata GET asserts gzip/cache metadata; browser-equivalent decoded media GET checks exact JSON bytes; SDK delete plus metadata 404 checks cleanup
points: after first import before browser launch
after same-store reopen and browser verification, with browser closed
measurement: Preserve every warmup and measured operation latency. Sample only the owned native process RSS every 100 ms; client compression/SDK/network work is included in elapsed latency but client/Java/Functions/browser RSS is excluded. A sampled maximum is not a continuous high-water guarantee
order: Published then corrected, corrected then published, published then corrected; never concurrent stacks
identity: Keep exact package/binary, Node, pinned SDK/peer, driver, fixture and contract hashes. Preserve failed attempts. No changes to swappiness, memory or worker limits
decision: No required performance winner. Investigate demonstrated regressions before adopting a product change. These synthetic sizes and same-host observations do not qualify full-data consumer memory, official comparison or endurance
